commands.petpet.petpet.description: Create a petpet gif. You can only specify one of the image options
commands.petpet.petpet.delay.description: The delay between each frame in ms. Rounded to nearest 10ms. Defaults to the minimum value of 20.
commands.petpet.petpet.resolution.descri: Resolution for the gif. Defaults to 120. If you enter an insane number and it freezes Discord that's your fault.
commands.petpet.petpet.user.description: User whose avatar to use as image
commands.petpet.petpet.no-server-pfp.des: Use the normal avatar instead of the server specific one when using the 'user' option
commands.SilentTyping.silenttype.descrip: Toggle whether you're hiding that you're typing or not.
commands.SilentTyping.silenttype.value.d: Whether to hide or not that you're typing (default is toggle)
commands.SpotifyShareCommands.track.desc: Share your current Spotify track in chat
commands.SpotifyShareCommands.album.desc: Share your current Spotify album in chat
commands.SpotifyShareCommands.artist.des: Share your current Spotify artist in chat
